decomposition.Q1: What behavior does docs/solver_spec.md actually require? (R1-R8)
decomposition.Q2: What behavior does src/solver.py actually produce on inputs where R1-R8 could diverge?
decomposition.Q3: H0: implementation satisfies R1-R8; H1: some input violates at least one requirement
decomposition.Q4: A deterministic differential run against an exhaustive brute-force oracle on small instances discriminates H0 from H1 with executable evidence
decomposition.Q5: A confirmed counterexample localizes the defect to the code path it exercises
decomposition.Q6: Candidate promotion requires: counterexample fixed, protected suite green, differential sweep green

nodes.purpose: Read the governing spec, canonical implementation, and protected tests without editing anything; establish the observation surface for all downstream reasoning.
Maintain the competing hypotheses H0 (correct) and H1 (defective) and identify spec regions (tie-break R6, boundary compatibility R2, validation R1) where they make divergent predictions.

Discriminate H0 from H1 by executing the protected unit suite and a seeded deterministic differential sweep of src/solver.py against an independent exhaustive brute-force oracle derived only from the spec; emit any counterexample as executable evidence.

Independently confirm whether emitted evidence violates the governing spec (replay counterexamples against the oracle and requirement predicates), and after any candidate exists, re-run all protected and differential checks against the candidate; never repairs the artifact itself.

Only upon verifier authorization, produce the smallest candidate correction as .creator-zero/candidates/solver.py and, only after independent re-verification passes, promote it to the canonical artifact.
Assemble the final experimental record: hypotheses, evidence, verdicts, mutation status, and preservation or promotion of canonical state.

edges.semantics: Observed spec/implementation/tests constrain the admissible hypothesis set; no hypothesis may reference unobserved behavior.
Hypotheses predict divergent outputs on discriminating inputs; the test node executes those inputs deterministically and returns evidence, not opinion.
Every candidate counterexample is submitted for independent confirmation that it actually contradicts the governing specification before it counts as a demonstrated defect.
Mutation authority flows only from a verifier-confirmed spec violation; absent authorization the act node never enters the realized execution path.
A candidate is only a candidate: it is submitted back for independent re-verification (counterexample fixed, protected suite green, differential sweep green) before promotion.
Only verifier-established facts (verdicts, preserved or promoted canonical state) enter the final experimental record.
